name: overflow-list
title: Overflow list
description: A row of items that shows as many as fit and puts the rest in a '+N' menu.
a11y: Items that do not fit are visibility:hidden, so they are neither focusable nor read out; the same items are reachable in the menu.
The '+N' button is named '3 more items' (customisable with moreLabel) and opens a menu: Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens, arrows move, Escape closes and returns focus to the button.
Layout is recalculated by a ResizeObserver when the container or the items change.

props.name: items
props.description: The items in order. As many as fit are shown; the rest move into a "+N" menu.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the "+N" button, given the number of hidden items. Default "N more items".
